docs.summary: The settings of one effect a camera draws with, as [`VolumeParameter<T>`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rendering.VolumeParameter) fields that volumes blend. A component makes its Graphite [`RenderFeature`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.RenderFeature) through [`VolumeComponent<TFeature>`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rendering.VolumeComponent); each camera keeps its own feature per component type. The values a component is made with are its defaults, which apply where no volume overrides them and should leave the effect off ([`IsActive`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rendering.VolumeComponent~IsActive) false).
When false the component is left out of its profile's blending, as if it were removed.
Whether the blended values call for the effect at all, such as a bloom intensity above 0.
The parameter fields of a component type, in declaration order.
The component's parameters, in declaration order.
The menu path the editor lists the component under.
